answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independently verified fraud links it to prior identities. A newcomer can still join, but creating thousands of Sybils means locking up capital for each one, while detection puts that capital at risk; the attacker must pay more than the cheap cost of generating accounts. The stake does not prove a person is unique, but it makes flooding costly. An ember of trust, ivory credentials, or nectar rewards cannot substitute for that economic commitment.
